{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert `revenue` to numeric: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = completed_orders[qa_mask]

# Exclude QA orders to get real completed orders
real_completed = completed_orders[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue_real = real_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the key numbers
len(qa_orders), qa_orders['revenue'].unique(), mean_revenue_real"}
